limits: In a blend, Pinot Gris: at most 30%
In a blend, Muscat Blanc, Muscat à Petits Grains Roses and Muscat Ottonel together: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

land: Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.

blurb.text: An Alsace Grand Cru vineyard in Ammerschwihr. Its main allowed grapes are Pinot Gris, Riesling and Gewürztraminer, with the three Muscats allowed as minor grapes.
